status: Operational research design; all 100 original packet IDs and native B owners retained. Packet completion is unobserved unless a later source-bound run proves it.
scope: Existing account01/B01-B20 only; no new agents, native jobs, recurrence reset or deadline extension. F groups are topical crosswalks for the same effort.

current_public_paper.status: Publication verified by the parent task; data-availability paragraph revised to URL only; mathematics unchanged from the reviewed 38-page baseline.

input_dependency_policy: input_packet_ids are preferred source handoffs to inspect and derive locally if absent. They are not theorem assumptions or prerequisites that every upstream research objective be solved. A refuted input triggers a new-version repair, scoped theorem or counterexample; it never licenses using a false lemma.
proof_dependency_policy: For every claimed result, populate proof_dependencies with claim ID, exact version/hash, hypotheses and evidence state. A complete proof may use only established dependencies (or explicitly discharged assumptions of a conditional theorem). Refutation invalidates descendants pending re-audit. No proof-dependency cycle is allowed.
review_policy: Suggested reviewer packet IDs route work, not evidence that reviewers ran. Actual author/reviewer identities must be distinct and source-bound; a contributor recuses from independent review of their own argument. Full-FEI candidates require complete independent reconstruction by eligible reviewers from both B18 and B19; a B17 certificate review does not replace either. If an audit stream contributed the candidate, use a different eligible reviewer in that stream and keep acceptance pending until available.
run_output_contract: Exact target and quantified scope; source pins actually read; full new proof, counterexample or derivation with first unsupported line.
Validation code, commands, actual outputs, exact tested domain and certified error bounds when computation is used.
Claim ID/version, actual proof dependencies, old-to-new mathematical delta, remaining debt and reviewer request.
Source-bound private open-problems commit and Brain handoff; save failure remains explicit.
A partial derivation can satisfy substantive-run work but does not complete the packet or prove its target.

observed_no_go.statement: For any fixed finite K,A,B>=0, some genuine Boolean physical split satisfies L>K*d+A*V+B*M.
observed_no_go.status: INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEWED / ACCEPT_AT_STATED_SCOPE; B19 reconstructed the analytic proof and an independent exact finite source with 16,404 assertions. This plan audit read the original B19 review; it does not claim to have rerun that checker itself.
observed_no_go.scope: Retires the universal all-node fixed-price local helper. Does not refute existential good-coordinate selection, adaptive stopping trees, a nonlocal logarithmic payment, or FEI.
observed_no_go.repair_requirement: Any proposed replacement must pay at least (k-O(1))*d on the archived family, or prove an additional condition that excludes it and is satisfied by the intended application.

reallocation_policy.after_3_unchanged_runs: B owner records the exact unchanged unpaid term and changes method, hypothesis, test family or nearest lemma.
reallocation_policy.after_6_unchanged_runs: B20 records a mathematical reassignment within existing B ownership and real capacity; it does not disable slots, create workers or revive obsolete work.
reallocation_policy.refuted_helper: Immediately stop using that exact helper, preserve statement and witness, invalidate proof descendants, and open a separately versioned repair or new route.
reallocation_policy.no_progress_definition: Renaming a residual, replaying an established check, adding prose, or repeating a known falsifier is not a mathematical delta.
reallocation_policy.positive_delta_definition: A proved bound on a previously unpaid term; a removed hypothesis; a meaningful new class; a rigorous new falsifier; an exact obstruction to an embedding; a validated finite-to-infinite bridge.
